headline: CSU Pueblo beat Colorado Christian and stay perfect
dek: CSU Pueblo beat Colorado Christian on Thursday for their fifth win in five matches, and have conceded one goal in all of them. Every other programme has dropped points; UCCS, the only other unbeaten side, have drawn nearly as often as they have won.
displaced_by: CSU Pueblo's fifth straight win, their first against another member, leaves them the only side without a dropped point; the Adams State goal is five days old.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The chart is stretched at both ends: UCCS have scored more goals than Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines and Adams State have together, and the sides in between sit within a few goals of one another.

wire.line: UCCS are unbeaten and have scored nineteen goals, but have drawn three of their seven matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines' goalless draw at Adams State on Wednesday is their second draw beside five defeats, and they remain the only side without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's win at Westminster on Thursday was their third of the season, beside two draws and one defeat, and they have conceded three goals in all.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State's draw with Colorado School of Mines is their first of the season; their one goal still stands alone against seven conceded, across a win, a draw and three defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Simão Agostinho has scored five goals for Fort Lewis from 21 shots, and has added one assist.

last_match.line: CSU Pueblo have yet to drop a point; Colorado Christian have not won since beating West Texas A&M.

next_match.line: Colorado School of Mines are still waiting for a first win; South Dakota Mines have lost only once.
